name: The Dust Porch
prompt: Give a lunar habitat three transparent airlock chambers. A rover returns to the outer chamber, brushes shake dust into a hopper and clean-suited crew step into the greenhouse.

name: The Long Shadow Garden
prompt: Place a compact lunar greenhouse beside a tracking mirror field. A mirror turns sunlight down a narrow shaft onto vegetable beds beneath a low regolith berm.

name: The Rover Tyre Shop
prompt: Open a low lunar repair shelter with a rover lifted on stands. Mechanics exchange a bent wire-mesh wheel while a line of wheel prints curls toward the pressure dome.

name: The Sample Library
prompt: Set a sealed geology archive beside a lunar landing platform. A manipulator moves striped rock cores from a rover tray into a fan of shallow glass storage drawers.

name: The Inflatable Wing
prompt: Show a lunar habitat extension at three stages: rolled fabric, half-inflated ribs and an occupied pressure room. Crew fasten the outer shell to anchor blocks from a low walkway.
